Identification_Area.title: MARS SCIENCE LABORATORY ROVER ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING STATION

Modification_Detail.description: This label was modified to convert to PDS4.

Field_Character.name: TIMESTAMP
Field_Character.description: Number of seconds since noon 1-Jan-2000

Field_Character.name: LMST
Field_Character.description: Local Mean Solar Time. It is in the format SSSSSMHH:MM:SS.sss where: SS - Sol number (00000-99999) M - sol/time separator HH - hour (0-23) MM - minute (0-59) SS - second (0-59) sss - fractions of second (000-999)

Field_Character.name: LTST
Field_Character.description: Local True Solar Time with respect to the rover position. It is in the format SSSSS HH:MM:SS.sss where: SS - Sol number (00000-99999) HH - hour (0-23) MM - minute (0-59) SS - second (0-59)

Field_Character.name: UV_DUST_ATTENUATION
Field_Character.description: Magnitude of the attenuation produced by dust deposited over the UV sensor (1 = no attenuation; 0 = total attenuation)

Field_Character.name: TIMESTAMP
Field_Character.description: Number of seconds since noon 1-Jan-2000

Field_Character.name: LMST
Field_Character.description: Local Mean Solar Time. It is in the format SSSSSMHH:MM:SS.sss where: SS - Sol number (00000-99999) M - sol/time separator HH - hour (0-23) MM - minute (0-59) SS - second (0-59) sss - fractions of second (000-999)

Field_Character.name: LTST
Field_Character.description: Local True Solar Time with respect to the rover position. It is in the format SSSSS HH:MM:SS.sss where: SS - Sol number (00000-99999) HH - hour (0-23) MM - minute (0-59) SS - second (0-59)

Field_Character.name: SOLAR_LONGITUDE_ANGLE
Field_Character.description: Solar azimuth angle relative to REMS rover frame (+X points to the front of the rover; +Z points up; +Y completes the right handed frame; the origin is on the rover deck, between the rover middle wheels) It is the angle between the positive X-axis and the orthogonal projection of the Sun onto the XY plane. It increases in the counterclockwise sense about the positive Z-axis. Range of -180 to 180 degrees.

Field_Character.name: SOLAR_ZENITHAL_ANGLE
Field_Character.description: Solar elevation angle relative to REMS rover frame (+X points to the front of the rover; +Z points up; +Y completes the right handed frame; the origin is on the rover deck, between the rover middle wheels) It is the angle between the direction of the Sun and the positive Z-axis. A value of 0 degrees represents Sun at frame's zenith, while a value of 180 degrees represents Sun at frame's nadir. Range of 0 to 180 degrees.

Field_Character.name: ROVER_POSITION_X
Field_Character.description: Rover position relative to landing site. It is the x-component of the rover's position relative to landing site, expressed with respect to MSL_TOPO frame (+X is along the local north direction; +Z is along the outward normal at the landing site; +Y completes the right hand frame; the origin of this frame is located at the landing site)

Field_Character.name: ROVER_POSITION_Y
Field_Character.description: Rover position relative to landing site. It is the y-component of the rover's position relative to landing site, expressed with respect to MSL_TOPO frame (+X is along the local north direction; +Z is along the outward normal at the landing site; +Y completes the right hand frame; the origin of this frame is located at the landing site)

Field_Character.name: ROVER_POSITION_Z
Field_Character.description: Rover position relative to landing site. It is the z-component of the rover's position relative to landing site, expressed with respect to MSL_TOPO frame (+X is along the local north direction; +Z is along the outward normal at the landing site; +Y completes the right hand frame; the origin of this frame is located at the landing site)

Field_Character.name: ROVER_VELOCITY
Field_Character.description: Rover velocity

Field_Character.name: ROVER_PITCH
Field_Character.description: Rover pitch, or counterclockwise rotation angle about the +Y-axis of the MSL_LOCAL_LEVEL frame. MSL_LOCAL_LEVEL frame is defined as follows: +X is along the local north direction; +Z is along the downward normal at the landing site; +Y completes the right hand frame; the origin of this frame is located between the rover's middle wheels and moves with the rover.

Field_Character.name: ROVER_YAW
Field_Character.description: Rover yaw, or counterclockwise rotation angle about the +Z-axis of the MSL_LOCAL_LEVEL frame. MSL_LOCAL_LEVEL frame is defined as follows: +X is along the local north direction; +Z is along the downward normal at the landing site; +Y completes the right hand frame; the origin of this frame is located between the rover's middle wheels and moves with the rover.

Field_Character.name: ROVER_ROLL
Field_Character.description: Rover roll, or counterclockwise rotation angle about the +X-axis of the MSL_LOCAL_LEVEL frame. MSL_LOCAL_LEVEL frame is defined as follows: +X is along the local north direction; +Z is along the downward normal at the landing site; +Y completes the right hand frame; the origin of this frame is located between the rover's middle wheels and moves with the rover.

Field_Character.name: MASTHEAD_AZIMUTH
Field_Character.description: Masthead azimuth angle. Range of -180 to 180 degrees. An azimuth angle of 1 degree represents rover looking backward, an azimuth angle of 91 degrees represents rover looking to the left, an azimuth angle of -179 degrees represents rover looking forward, and an azimuth angle of -89 degrees represents rover looking to the right.

Field_Character.name: MASTHEAD_ELEVATION
Field_Character.description: Masthead elevation angle. Range of 0 to 360 degrees. An elevation angle of 1 degree represents rover looking down, an elevation angle of 91 degrees represents rover looking forward and an elevation angle of 181 degrees represents rover looking at the zenith.

Field_Character.name: ARM_STILL
Field_Character.description: Flag to indicate whether the arm is still; 1 = still; 0 = in motion.

Field_Character.name: ARM_STOWED
Field_Character.description: Flag to indicate whether the arm is stowed; 1 = stowed; 0 = unstowed.
